assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: seamless repeating base-color texture for an isometric medieval dungeon game.
Input image 1: edit target, the existing texture.
Style: believable tactile semi-realistic game material. A flat edge-to-edge opaque RGB square texture swatch, 1024x1024. Keep existing surface geometry, feature placement, scale, cracks, orthographic view and framing. Material color only with even diffuse illumination; no baked directional light or glossy specular reflections. Weathering must remain legible at game camera distance, with irregular broad patches plus fine detail, never uniform noise. Seamless periodic wrap on all four edges; avoid edge borders or a bright/dark frame. No text, objects, perspective, decorative elements or scene.
Primary request: Convert ALL red terracotta bricks into aged cool neutral grey dressed stone blocks, charcoal-slate grey with restrained taupe variation. Absolutely no red/orange clay color. Preserve the exact running-bond joint layout and block faces from the input: this texture's rectangles are sampled by the game's 3D wall geometry. Darken the pale mortar to dirty grey. Add years of ingrained dirt, dark damp stains, thin uneven vertical seepage trails running down block faces, small muted dark olive moss colonies chiefly in mortar and crevices (about 12 percent coverage), restrained mineral drip residue, pitted and chipped worn surfaces. Moderate dark midtones with readable grey stone surfaces; not near-black. No clean new blocks, bright green, wet gloss, large missing blocks, changes to seams or their coordinates.
